newsitem.title: USA: Harris & Harris unit names president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Harris & Harris unit names president/CEO.

text.p: Harris & Harris Group said on Monday its 22.5 percent-owned affiliate, PowerVoice Technologies Inc, has named Daniel Massiello president and chief executive.
Massiello most recently was at Lucent Technologies Inc as general manager of the mass markets portion of the small business division, the company said.
PowerVoice was formed in 1996 to commercialize innovative technology for voice communications over data networks. Harris & Harris Group is a business development company.
